caption.instagram:
Not every "open" extern posting is a vacancy right now.

Mackenzie Health's posting says it "is not for an existing vacancy". SHN's is titled "Talent Pool, 2026". Southlake's lists 40 positions. Sunnybrook's doesn't say either way.

Both talent-pool postings say they're for upcoming or future openings. You're applying to be considered later, not for one job that exists today.

The free tracker labels every Ontario extern posting by type, with the hospital's own link. Link in bio. Not affiliated with any hospital.
